reason: The published @lumis-sh/wasm-* package for these languages is either not installed or was built from an older languages.toml revision, so it cannot verify the current processed queries. test/query-compile.test.ts falls back to a locally built parser when one exists, and `mise run test-queries` builds exactly these before requiring complete coverage. Regenerate with `node scripts/list-parsers.mjs --unverified`. This list may only shrink; delete entries as the parser packages are republished.

cannotCompile.llvm: no queries: nvim-treesitter ships none, so queries/processed/llvm does not exist
cannotCompile.php: the parser traps while parsing samples/php.php (memory access out of bounds) at the revision languages.toml pins. Reproduces in web-tree-sitter and in wasmtime, and with the published package, so it is the grammar rather than the build.

cannotCompileReason: Languages whose queries cannot be checked even with a parser built from languages.toml, with the reason for each. Separate from `languages`, which records what npm has fallen behind on. This list may only shrink: the complete-coverage check fails on an entry that has started working.
